summary: 'Good job' is GOOD followed by WORK (two S fists, one tapping the other at the wrist), usually with a nod of approval.
steps: Sign GOOD: flat hand from the chin landing on the other palm.
Sign WORK: make two fists and tap the dominant one on the back of the other at the wrist, twice.
mistakes: Rushing WORK into a single tap. Two taps.
